import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { changesetComments } from "./changeset_comments";
import { changesets } from "./changesets";
import { diaryComments } from "./diary_comments";
import { diaryEntries } from "./diary_entries";
import { friends } from "./friends";
import { gpxFiles } from "./gpx_files";
import { issueComments } from "./issue_comments";
import { issues } from "./issues";
import { messages } from "./messages";
import { noteComments } from "./note_comments";
import { notes } from "./notes";
import { oauthAccessGrants } from "./oauth_access_grants";
import { oauthAccessTokens } from "./oauth_access_tokens";
import { oauthApplications } from "./oauth_applications";
import { redactions } from "./redactions";
import { reports } from "./reports";
import { socialLinks } from "./social_links";
import { userBlocks } from "./user_blocks";
import { userMutes } from "./user_mutes";
import { userPreferences } from "./user_preferences";
import { userRoles } from "./user_roles";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "email" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "pass_crypt" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "creation_time" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "display_name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "pass_salt" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "new_email" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "languages" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "terms_agreed" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "auth_uid" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "preferred_editor" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "auth_provider" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "tou_agreed" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "creation_address" is inet, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
//   - "home_location_name" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "company" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const users = defineTable("users", {
    columns: {
        email: col.text().notNull().unique(),
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        passCrypt: col.text().notNull(),
        creationTime: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        displayName: col.text().notNull().unique().default(""),
        dataPublic: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        description: col.text().notNull().default(""),
        homeLat: col.doublePrecision(),
        homeLon: col.doublePrecision(),
        homeZoom: col.smallint().default(3),
        passSalt: col.text(),
        emailValid: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        newEmail: col.text(),
        languages: col.text(),
        status: col.enum(["pending", "active", "confirmed", "suspended", "deleted"], { name: "user_status_enum" }).notNull().default("pending"),
        termsAgreed: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        considerPd: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        authUid: col.text(),
        preferredEditor: col.text(),
        termsSeen: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        descriptionFormat: col.enum(["html", "markdown", "text"], { name: "format_enum" }).notNull().default("markdown"),
        changesetsCount: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        tracesCount: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        diaryEntriesCount: col.integer().notNull().default(0),
        imageUseGravatar: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        authProvider: col.text(),
        homeTile: col.bigint(),
        touAgreed: col.custom("timestamp without time zone"),
        diaryCommentsCount: col.integer().default(0),
        noteCommentsCount: col.integer().default(0),
        creationAddress: col.custom("inet"),
        homeLocationName: col.text(),
        company: col.text(),
        publicHeatmap: col.boolean().notNull().default(true)
    },
    relations: {
        changeset_comments: rel.hasMany(() => changesetComments, { foreignKey: "author_id" }),
        changesets: rel.hasMany(() => changesets),
        diary_comments: rel.hasMany(() => diaryComments),
        diary_entries: rel.hasMany(() => diaryEntries),
        friends: rel.hasMany(() => friends, { foreignKey: "friend_user_id" }),
        friends_by_user_id: rel.hasMany(() => friends),
        gpx_files: rel.hasMany(() => gpxFiles),
        issue_comments: rel.hasMany(() => issueComments),
        issues: rel.hasMany(() => issues, { foreignKey: "reported_user_id" }),
        issues_by_resolved_by: rel.hasMany(() => issues, { foreignKey: "resolved_by" }),
        issues_by_updated_by: rel.hasMany(() => issues, { foreignKey: "updated_by" }),
        messages: rel.hasMany(() => messages, { foreignKey: "from_user_id" }),
        messages_by_to_user_id: rel.hasMany(() => messages, { foreignKey: "to_user_id" }),
        note_comments: rel.hasMany(() => noteComments, { foreignKey: "author_id" }),
        notes: rel.hasMany(() => notes),
        oauth_access_grants: rel.hasMany(() => oauthAccessGrants, { foreignKey: "resource_owner_id" }),
        oauth_access_tokens: rel.hasMany(() => oauthAccessTokens, { foreignKey: "resource_owner_id" }),
        oauth_applications: rel.hasMany(() => oauthApplications, { foreignKey: "owner_id" }),
        redactions: rel.hasMany(() => redactions),
        reports: rel.hasMany(() => reports),
        social_links: rel.hasMany(() => socialLinks),
        user_blocks: rel.hasMany(() => userBlocks, { foreignKey: "creator_id" }),
        user_blocks_by_revoker_id: rel.hasMany(() => userBlocks, { foreignKey: "revoker_id" }),
        user_blocks_by_user_id: rel.hasMany(() => userBlocks),
        user_mutes: rel.hasMany(() => userMutes, { foreignKey: "owner_id" }),
        user_mutes_by_subject_id: rel.hasMany(() => userMutes, { foreignKey: "subject_id" }),
        user_preferences: rel.hasMany(() => userPreferences),
        user_roles: rel.hasMany(() => userRoles, { foreignKey: "granter_id" }),
        user_roles_by_user_id: rel.hasMany(() => userRoles),
        changesets_via_changesets_subscribers: rel.manyToMany(() => changesets, {
            through: "changesets_subscribers",
            sourceKey: "subscriber_id",
            targetKey: "changeset_id"
        }),
        diary_entries_via_diary_entry_subscriptions: rel.manyToMany(() => diaryEntries, {
            through: "diary_entry_subscriptions",
            targetKey: "diary_entry_id"
        }),
        notes_via_note_subscriptions: rel.manyToMany(() => notes, {
            through: "note_subscriptions",
            targetKey: "note_id"
        })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
